business_goal.value: Build a runnable tool that accepts one arbitrary game video, detects highlight moments with multiple signals, and exports MP4 highlight clips plus an explainable timeline.

scenarios.value: User selects one local gameplay video file.
System analyzes visual motion, audio peaks, speech/subtitle keywords, and dense event windows.
User reviews ranked highlight candidates and exports separate MP4 clips.

pain_points.value: Manual highlight finding requires repeatedly scrubbing through long gameplay footage.
Single-signal detection misses highlights when the excitement is visual, audio, or language-only.
Editors need tunable sensitivity and minimum duration instead of fixed clip rules.

scope_boundary.value: V1 runs locally with one uploaded/selected game video at a time; it produces ranked candidates, MP4 clips or a cut manifest, and an analysis report.
